# fifty50labs MCP server
> Remote MCP server (via Apify) with three pay-per-result tools: extract tables from scanned/Arabic PDFs to JSON, bulk domain availability via RDAP, Core Web Vitals pass/fail verdicts.
- Endpoint: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=fifty50labs/pdf-table-extractor-arabic-ocr,fifty50labs/domain-availability-checker-rdap,fifty50labs/core-web-vitals-crux-median-check
- [PDF table extractor (Arabic OCR)](https://apify.com/fifty50labs/pdf-table-extractor-arabic-ocr): $15/1k pages
- [Domain availability (RDAP)](https://apify.com/fifty50labs/domain-availability-checker-rdap): $15/1k domains
- [Core Web Vitals verdict](https://apify.com/fifty50labs/core-web-vitals-crux-median-check): $25/1k audits
